scenarios.name: Python learning desk
scenarios.summary: A fictional learner at a small stationery desk builds notebook-order helpers and practices with product quantities, color labels, token grouping and sample grade scores. All examples are authored teaching fixtures, not observations about real customers or businesses.

assets.title: orders.csv
assets.description: The exact illustrative CSV fixture for python.file_io. The quantity column is a count; csv.DictReader returns its CSV text as a string, not as an inferred integer. Alternate fixtures support content-dependent hidden checks.

columns.name: label
columns.description: Product label used as the CSV record category.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Whole-number quantity; CSV readers expose the serialized value as text, not a numeric-looking category label.

variants.purpose: Alternate authored CSV fixture for checking that the reader uses file contents rather than a hard-coded record.
